tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: WhatsApp green, the identity colour. Fills only: send orb, unread badge, progress, toggle-on track, the logo. Never text: it is 2:1 on white. Content on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Pointer-over state of a `brand` fill (Windows `AppAccentBrushPointerOver`).

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a `brand` fill (Windows `AppAccentBrushPressed`).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Glyphs and numerals on a `brand` fill: the send arrow, the unread count. 9.4:1. Never white on `brand`.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent text and icons: reply sender, 'Replying to', links, document icon, Open pill label, typing dots in a row. At least 5:1 on `bubble-in`, `glass-regular`, `glass-thick` and on `accent-wash` in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-ink-out
tokens.usage: Accent text inside an outgoing bubble. Dark theme needs a lighter green because `bubble-out` is itself green; 4.5:1 on `bubble-out` and on `accent-wash` over it.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Green-tinted glass behind accent content: Open pill, typing capsule, archived disc, jump-to-highlight row, drop overlay.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px. 3.6:1 on `wallpaper` and 4.4:1 on `sidebar-ground` (light); 8.8:1 or better in dark.

tokens.name: wallpaper
tokens.usage: Chat thread ground, the WhatsApp beige / night. Everything in the thread floats above it; header and composer glass sample it.

tokens.name: wallpaper-glow
tokens.usage: Soft radial light painted on `wallpaper` (two blobs, top-left and bottom-right) so glass has colour to refract. Decorative; text contrast is computed against it as the worst case.

tokens.name: wallpaper-glow-alt
tokens.usage: Second, teal wallpaper glow. Pairs with `wallpaper-glow`; never on its own.

tokens.name: sidebar-ground
tokens.usage: What the sidebar glass settles to with transparency off, and the Mica tint colour on Windows.

tokens.name: glass-clear
tokens.usage: Clearest glass: floating controls over busy content (jump-to-latest, media overlays, toolbar buttons). Icons only; no body text on it.

tokens.name: glass-regular
tokens.usage: The default glass: chat header, composer pill, sidebar panel, transfer banner, host indicator base.

tokens.name: glass-thick
tokens.usage: Dense glass for reading: sheets, consent panel, menus, settings groups, popovers.

tokens.name: glass-regular-fallback
tokens.usage: Opaque stand-in for `glass-regular` when transparency is off (Reduce Transparency, battery saver, remote session). WinUI `AcrylicBrush.FallbackColor`.

tokens.name: glass-thick-fallback
tokens.usage: Opaque stand-in for `glass-thick` when transparency is off.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: The specular top edge: a 1px inset highlight along the upper rim of every glass shape. It is what makes a translucent panel read as glass rather than as fog.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Start of the lensing gradient: fades from the top of a glass shape to transparent by 55% of its height.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px outline around every glass shape, so glass stays separated from glass of the same tint.

tokens.name: glass-hover
tokens.usage: Hover layer on glass controls (Windows `AppIconHoverBrush`, #2E808080).

tokens.name: glass-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed layer on glass controls (Windows `AppIconPressedBrush`, #46808080).

tokens.name: inset-fill
tokens.usage: Recessed fill inside a bubble or sheet: reply chip, address/key card, text field, toggle-off track, progress track.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dark glass behind white text over photos and video: the media time pill, the play disc. `ink-inverse` holds 4.6:1 on it even over a white photo.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows inside one glass panel. Never between two glass panels: they are separated by space and `glass-edge`.

tokens.name: bubble-in
tokens.usage: Incoming message bubble: WhatsApp white / #202c33 as tinted glass.

tokens.name: bubble-out
tokens.usage: Outgoing message bubble: WhatsApp #dcf8c6 / #005c4b as tinted glass.

tokens.name: bubble-in-fallback
tokens.usage: Opaque incoming bubble with transparency off; the original WhatsApp value.

tokens.name: bubble-out-fallback
tokens.usage: Opaque outgoing bubble with transparency off; the original WhatsApp value.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: names, message bodies, titles. 7.2:1 or better on every surface in both themes, including `bubble-out` dark.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: previews, statuses, captions, placeholders, 'edited'. 4.7:1 or better on `bubble-in`, `glass-regular`, `glass-thick`, `sidebar-ground`, `wallpaper`. Not for `bubble-out`: use `meta-out`.

tokens.name: meta-out
tokens.usage: Time, 'edited', 'via relay' and sent ticks inside an outgoing bubble. 5:1 on `bubble-out` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on saturated fills: avatar initials, `danger` fill labels.

tokens.name: tick-read
tokens.usage: Read double-tick. 3.5:1 on `bubble-out`, 4:1 on `bubble-in` (icons need 3:1). Replaces #4f9ef7, which was 2.6:1 on the light outgoing bubble.

tokens.name: presence-online
tokens.usage: Online dot. Light is a deeper green than `brand` so the dot holds 3.4:1 against its white ring.

tokens.name: presence-offline
tokens.usage: Offline dot. 3.6:1 against the white ring in light.

tokens.name: presence-ring
tokens.usage: 2px ring around a presence dot where it overlaps an avatar (Windows `AppOnlineDotStrokeBrush`).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fills with `ink-inverse` text (4.8:1): the Stop Sharing button, Delete conversation.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Failed-send icon and destructive text on glass and bubbles. 3.4:1 or better as an icon on `bubble-out` dark, 4.8:1 elsewhere.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted glass behind a destructive note or the controlled-state indicator.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution fills. Content on it is `on-warning`, not white (white is 2.4:1). Not used by the screen-sharing indicator, which is neutral.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `warning` fill. 7:1.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Caution text and icons on glass: the consent panel's security note. 5.8:1 on `glass-thick`.

tokens.name: warning-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted glass behind a caution note.

tokens.name: hud-surface
tokens.usage: The screen-sharing indicator's surface: an always-dark, solid capsule, identical in light and dark themes, so it reads as system chrome over any desktop and is never washed out by what is behind it.

tokens.name: hud-rim
tokens.usage: The indicator's 1px edge, which separates it from a dark desktop.

tokens.name: hud-ink
tokens.usage: Headline and button text on `hud-surface`. 15:1.

tokens.name: hud-ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Elapsed time and secondary text on `hud-surface`. 7.3:1.

tokens.name: hud-button
tokens.usage: Neutral button fill inside the indicator (Stop Control). `hud-ink` on it is 10:1.

tokens.name: hud-button-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `hud-button`.

tokens.name: hud-signal-view
tokens.usage: The breathing status dot while the screen is being viewed. 7.9:1 on `hud-surface`. A dot, never a fill.

tokens.name: hud-signal-control
tokens.usage: The status dot and 1px outline while the machine is being controlled. 5.6:1 on `hud-surface`. A dot and an outline, never a fill.

tokens.name: avatar-blue
tokens.usage: Avatar fill 0 of 8, chosen by FNV-1a of the contact's name modulo 8 on both platforms. White initials at 4.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: avatar-green
tokens.usage: Avatar fill 1 of 8, chosen by FNV-1a of the contact's name modulo 8 on both platforms. White initials at 4.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: avatar-orange
tokens.usage: Avatar fill 2 of 8, chosen by FNV-1a of the contact's name modulo 8 on both platforms. White initials at 4.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: avatar-purple
tokens.usage: Avatar fill 3 of 8, chosen by FNV-1a of the contact's name modulo 8 on both platforms. White initials at 4.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: avatar-red
tokens.usage: Avatar fill 4 of 8, chosen by FNV-1a of the contact's name modulo 8 on both platforms. White initials at 4.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: avatar-teal
tokens.usage: Avatar fill 5 of 8, chosen by FNV-1a of the contact's name modulo 8 on both platforms. White initials at 4.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: avatar-amber
tokens.usage: Avatar fill 6 of 8, chosen by FNV-1a of the contact's name modulo 8 on both platforms. White initials at 4.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: avatar-slate
tokens.usage: Avatar fill 7 of 8, chosen by FNV-1a of the contact's name modulo 8 on both platforms. White initials at 4.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: name over status in the header, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Meta row gaps, pill vertical padding, message row gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Reply-chip padding, icon-to-label in small pills.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Composer vertical padding, pill horizontal padding, gaps between glass controls.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Bubble horizontal padding, row avatar-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Thread side gutter, file-bubble padding, composer horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Banner horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Header horizontal padding, sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Floating glass inset from the window edge; sheet section gaps.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding, space above a floating composer.

tokens.name: radius-tail
tokens.usage: The tail corner of the first bubble in a run (bottom-leading incoming, bottom-trailing outgoing). Reply thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Reply chip inside a bubble (16 − 10 padding, concentric).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Notes and inline cards inside a sheet.

tokens.name: radius-media
tokens.usage: Image and video inside a media bubble (16 − 4 inset).

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Every message bubble's non-tail corners; the typing bubble.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Selected and hover highlight on a sidebar row.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Floating glass panels: sidebar panel, transfer banner, grouped settings.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and consent windows. Inner content follows concentricity: sheet radius − padding.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsules: composer, header, host indicator, badges, pill buttons, icon buttons.

shadow.note: Glass lifts by rim and blur, not by darkness. Shadows stay short and soft; the rim highlight lives in `shadow-rim` and is combined with a lift.

tokens.name: shadow-rim
tokens.usage: The specular rim on every glass shape: a bright top edge and a faint bottom edge.

tokens.name: shadow-bubble
tokens.usage: Message bubbles: WhatsApp's own hairline drop.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating glass: composer, header capsule, jump-to-latest, host indicator. WinUI ThemeShadow at Translation Z 16.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, consent windows, menus. WinUI ThemeShadow at Translation Z 32.

blur.note: Backdrop blur radius per glass thickness. WinUI in-app AcrylicBrush has a fixed blur; these apply to CSS and to macOS fallbacks.

tokens.name: blur-clear
tokens.usage: `glass-clear`.

tokens.name: blur-regular
tokens.usage: `glass-regular`.

tokens.name: blur-thick
tokens.usage: `glass-thick`.

tokens.name: saturate-glass
tokens.usage: Saturation boost applied with every blur, so the wallpaper's green reads through as colour rather than grey.

acrylic.note: WinUI 3 AcrylicBrush parameters for each glass thickness. TintColor is the glass token's RGB; TintOpacity and TintLuminosityOpacity are below.
